course_duration_lock_ck.name: course_duration_lock_ck
course_duration_lock_ck.value: "course"."duration_locked_at" is null or "course"."access_duration_months" is not null

section_review_comment_ck.name: section_review_comment_ck
section_review_comment_ck.value: "section_review"."comment" is null or char_length("section_review"."comment") between 1 and 2000

subscription_plan_version_item_ref_ck.name: subscription_plan_version_item_ref_ck
subscription_plan_version_item_ref_ck.value:
("subscription_plan_version_item"."item_type" = 'course' and "subscription_plan_version_item"."course_id" is not null and "subscription_plan_version_item"."exam_package_id" is null)
        or ("subscription_plan_version_item"."item_type" = 'exam_package' and "subscription_plan_version_item"."exam_package_id" is not null and "subscription_plan_version_item"."course_id" is null)

refund_decision_ck.name: refund_decision_ck
refund_decision_ck.value: ("refund_request"."status" = 'pending') = ("refund_request"."decided_at" is null) and ("refund_request"."status" <> 'approved' or ("refund_request"."policy" is not null and "refund_request"."refund_poisha" >= 1))

vault_item_lesson_ref_ck.name: vault_item_lesson_ref_ck
vault_item_lesson_ref_ck.value: "vault_item"."source" <> 'lesson' or ("vault_item"."lesson_id" is not null and "vault_item"."course_id" is not null)

exam_title_ck.name: exam_title_ck
exam_title_ck.value: char_length("exam"."title_bn") between 1 and 150 and char_length("exam"."title_en") between 1 and 150

subject_name_ck.name: subject_name_ck
subject_name_ck.value: char_length("subject"."name_bn") between 1 and 80 and char_length("subject"."name_en") between 1 and 80

topic_name_ck.name: topic_name_ck
topic_name_ck.value: char_length("topic"."name_bn") between 1 and 120 and char_length("topic"."name_en") between 1 and 120

battle_hosted_ck.name: battle_hosted_ck
battle_hosted_ck.value: "battle"."mode" <> 'hosted' or ("battle"."starts_at" is not null and "battle"."title_en" is not null)

live_class_title_ck.name: live_class_title_ck
live_class_title_ck.value: char_length("live_class"."title_bn") between 1 and 150 and char_length("live_class"."title_en") between 1 and 150

payout_account_bank_ck.name: payout_account_bank_ck
payout_account_bank_ck.value: "payout_account"."rail" <> 'bank' or ("payout_account"."bank_name" is not null and "payout_account"."routing_number" is not null)
